scope: Selected already-borrowed synchronous storage handles under exact injected Win32 API fixtures. Native device opens, enumeration, worker containment, identity admission and public inventory remain separate.
execution: Construction and invalid input dispatch no query. No target opens, handle closes, device-number-to-path opens, reads of media content, mutation IOCTLs, elevation, network or product startup integration. All subjects and policies validate before any query. The current port rejects both complete and mixed native pointer tables. This qualifies only the compiled fixture factory; pointer checks do not authenticate arbitrary wrappers.
borrowing: The caller retains handle ownership. The synchronous selected API sequence does not establish a universal latency bound, atomic capture, worker exit or handle retirement. An unexpected ERROR_IO_PENDING or callback exception quarantines the port and stops further queries and later subjects. Cancellation is checked before each dispatch including descriptor/extent growth; it does not prove process exit.
descriptor: One 8-byte header and at most one bounded full query. The selected layout has Version 40, 36-byte fixed prefix and a 40-byte C structure. Unknown versions remain unsupported. Declared size, actual returned bytes, field offsets, NUL termination and opaque property length are checked independently. Header/body size or version disagreement and repeated growth are changed observations. Preserve absent versus empty ASCII fields, original bytes and inert display escapes; non-ASCII bytes remain visible as nonconforming data. Bus properties remain uninterpreted.
quantities: Preserve device numbers only as transient lookup hints; the all-ones partition number is explicit absence. Decode signed LARGE_INTEGER fields without casting unaligned buffers. Negative geometry/capacity/ranges, zero extent length and signed end overflow are invalid. Empty extent arrays remain empty observations. Logical sector bytes may be non-powers of two; physical sector size is not inferred. Geometry translation is not multiplied into capacity. Independently observed geometry and length disagreement remains explicit.
topology: A volume's extents are retained individually. ERROR_MORE_DATA permits one growth from its returned count; changed counts/repeated growth never loop. Match whole-disk number observations only within the current sequential fixture capture. Preserve unresolved/ambiguous candidates and ranges exceeding observed capacity. No physical backing edge or media merge is inferred. Cloned serial strings and duplicate number observations remain separate records with conflict flags.
graph: Use the existing private observation graph profile. Each selected resource and extent has a distinct source/capture/worker/context/frame/payload-bound observation ID. Context is fixture input only, not an authenticated worker or media owner. The frame remains immutable. Its private bounded producer-conformance reader reconstructs content from exact returned-byte receipts and bound subjects/capture/policy; it supplies no public storage ABI or native provenance. Fixture-only projection and separately qualified owned-reader context remain distinct. Raw query receipts and opaque bytes remain in the frame; graph summaries retain their frame/property digests. Media identity, generation and physical capacity properties stay null; authority stays false.
required_checks: Exact SDK ABI and Win32 control/input/output arguments on x64 and x86.
No construction/invalid/native-table dispatch and no query reuse.
Byte/count/offset/string bounds, one growth, changed/truncated replies and opaque lossless metadata.
Immediate errors, unsupported APIs, cancellation, exception and pending quarantine with known independent metadata preserved.
Cloned identifiers, conflicting capacity, unresolved/ambiguous extents, signed ranges and source-bound graph identities without physical authority.
Exact source/build/launch/hash/import evidence, finite batch limits and retained failed probes.
